note: Co-operative Bank of Kenya's tariff guide (charges and fees as of 22 October 2026, the poster its home page links, read 2026-11-03; until then the one of 12 May 2025, read by eye, whose figures it repeats): an individual's current account carries an account maintenance fee of 300 shillings a month, before the excise duty the poster says applies to all fees without giving its rate; ledger fees of 35 shillings an entry aren't modelled. Its Hekima savings account carries no maintenance fee but limits counter withdrawals to one every three months.

sources.title: Co-op Bank Tariff Guide (charges and fees as of 22 October 2026), linked from https://www.co-opbank.co.ke/
